After न which is added to the roots of the रुधादिगणः (7th Conjugation) as a गणविकरण - श्नम् (characteristic), there is the elision of the following न।

Terms: अभीय Rules

Before a सार्वधातुक कित् or ङित् affix, the अ of श्न and अस् is elided.

Terms: कित् and ङित्

Before a सार्वधातुक कित् or ङित् affix beginning with a vowel, the long आ of श्ना (the विकरण of the क्र्यादिगणः (9th Conjugation)) and of the reduplicate अङ्ग (stems) is elided.

Terms: कित् and ङित्

स्नात्व्यी etc. are irregularly formed in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: छन्दस् substitution
